character.description: The same young adult male anime protagonist: dark brown hair in a half-up style, violet eyes, a composed expression and strong brows; a poised performer and expressive storyteller, wearing a sharply recognizable performance outfit with a clean silhouette and restrained decorative details with mod blue accents. Keep this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, and signature outfit in every scene.
consistency_rules: Use this exact protagonist identity in every scene; do not redesign, replace, or randomly reinterpret the character.
Preserve the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the signature outfit silhouette, defining accessories, and main color accents consistent across the entire music video.
Do not introduce another protagonist unless the lyrics or scene explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in checkerboard dance floor, swirling psychedelic wall, retro lounge with round chairs; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with tangerine, hot pink, mod blue, mustard yellow; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by tight symmetrical frame of patterned walls, fast whip-pan across color blocks, top-down spin over a checker floor; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
